title: 第2章  让本仙子看看，你这老树究竟怎么开花
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
“唉，丫头，再过三天，你就再也梦不到我了。”
李寒山望着河边的少女，轻轻叹了口气，从自己被合欢宗的人抓走说起，向少女讲起了整个事情的经过。
少女是他穿越第七天梦到的，自那以后，每隔一段时间，李寒山都会做这个奇怪的梦，梦中也总会有少女。
这已经是第三次了。
前两次两人相谈甚欢，已然处成了忘年交，以“大爷”“丫头”互称。
李寒山不知道少女是真实存在的活人，还是梦中的幻影。
穿越成一个没有金手指的百岁老人，这个梦成了李寒山唯一的慰藉，于是他隐隐把这个梦当成了自己的穿越者福利。
虽然，目前除了能在梦中见到少女外，还不知道有什么其它用途。
“合欢宗？这世上竟有如此邪恶的仙门！”
待李寒山讲完，少女“腾”地从巨石上站起，气得双颊晕红，眼神亮得惊人。
李寒山叹气：“可不是嘛，这仙门简直视人命为草芥。”
少女攥着小拳头，语气带着几分急切：“大爷，快告诉我合欢宗在哪，我这就去救你！”
“救我？”
李寒山苦笑一声，摆了摆手，“丫头，我也不知道合欢宗在哪啊。”
他对少女可没抱多大希望，少女是不是真人都两说，就算真存在，她一个小姑娘，又怎么可能从满是修仙者的合欢宗里救走自己呢？
“这可麻烦了......天下仙门虽多，可合欢宗我从未听闻，就算能找到位置，三天之内也根本赶不及。”
少女皱起小眉头，愁容满面。
她是真心想救李寒山，也想除魔卫道，可仔细一思量，就知道这根本就是天方夜谭。
“丫头，你有心了，我这一把老骨头，死就死吧。”
李寒山看开了。

现在的局面，于他来说是纯纯的死局，看不到半点活命的希望。
以他的身子骨，花弄影只要一次采补，铁定归西。
从昏迷前花弄影那副气急败坏的样子来看，他绝不觉得这妖女会留着自己这条命。
“丫头，我们相识了这么久，还不知道你的名字呢。我姓李，李寒山。”李寒山问。
死之前，好歹让他知道这丫头的名字。
“大爷，我叫洛璃。”
少女在李寒山的语气中听出了交待后事的感觉，神色有些黯然。
“洛璃？好名字！”
李寒山感叹到，脑海中却莫名闪过昏迷前的记忆。
花弄影提到的祖师，似乎也姓洛？
“对了大爷，你说合欢宗的修士，都是靠采补别人来修炼？”
洛璃忽然脸上一红，像是想到了什么，声音也小了下去。
“我这里有一门功法，兴许能帮到你。”
说话间，洛璃伸出纤纤玉指，在半空中快速书写，一个个古朴的文字浮现，如流光般在虚空中排布开来。
“丫头，这是什么？”李寒山抬头。
“几个月前，我在一处古遗迹里找到的，是一门异常霸道功法，分阴、阳两册，阴册主采……主掠夺，阳册则是克制掠夺之法，大爷，我把阳册传给你，说不定能救你一命！”
“功法？”
李寒山盯着空中文字，只觉得每个字都认识，可组合在一起后，他就完全不理解了。
“丫头，这功法看着高深莫测，我能学会吗？”
李寒山满心担忧。

这些天，虽然天天泡药汤，身体强壮不少，可他在修炼一途仍然是小白一枚。
花弄影做的一切，应该是想激发他的纯阳圣体，而不是帮他提升修为。
“大爷放心，我教你！你先仔细记下来。”
洛璃的手没有停下，依旧在快速书写。
见洛璃如此尽心尽力，李寒山也收起杂念，拼命记忆。
洛璃在一旁耐心讲解，深入浅出，将晦涩的奥义拆解开来。
李寒山一边记一边听，渐渐明白了其中的门道。
“丫头怕也是修仙者。”
李寒山暗自猜测。
不知道以后有没有机会见到她。
随着洛璃一遍又一遍的讲解，李寒山对这门功法的理解越来越深。
这门功法施展起来其实不难，哪怕没有修为的凡人也可以上手
但生效有个前提：掠夺者的修为，不能高出李寒山太多。
“那妖女连大爷你都看得上，修为想必高不到哪去，大爷你不用担心！。”
洛璃信心十足地拍着胸脯安慰。
李寒山心里一暖，倒也没怎么担心，反正这是最后一搏，成与不成都在此一举！
“丫头，我记熟了。”
不知过了多久，李寒山感觉对功法的理解已经足够透彻，开口道。
洛璃闻言大喜，眼睛亮晶晶的：“太好了大爷！那我再教你开脉！”
李寒山一脸茫然：“丫头，开脉是什么？”

少女耐心解释：“想要修炼，得先有灵根，但光有灵根还不够，必须开灵脉，方可让灵气在体内运行无阻！”
原来如此。
李寒山穿越前没少看网文，理解起来不难。
“阳册不仅反掠夺，还能悄无声息从采……从掠夺者那里捞好处，来这里坐，我手把手教你开脉。”
洛璃拉着李寒山坐下，自己则坐到了他的身后。
“你……你先背过身去。”
李寒山依言转身。
下一秒，一双柔软的小手，轻轻贴在了他的后背上。
隔着薄薄的布料，李寒山清晰地感受到，身后的少女在发抖。
“丫头，你很冷吗？”李寒山干咳一声。
“不、不是……”洛璃的声音微不可闻，连带着呼吸都急促了几分，“大爷，这阳册功法霸道，开脉需走偏锋。气机……气机得从会阴穴过。”
会阴穴？
李寒山这个百岁老头，老脸也是一僵。
那可是命门私处！
“我、我要用灵力帮你强行冲开，所以……所以模拟的是双修采补之象。”
洛璃急急忙忙地解释，生怕李寒山误会。
李寒山回头瞥了一眼。
只见那白衣胜雪的丫头，此刻连白皙的脖颈都染上了一层粉红。
她紧紧咬着发白的下唇，眼眸湿漉漉的，根本不敢和李寒山对视。
“大爷，集中精神！”洛璃娇嗔了一句，强行板起小脸。

“好。”李寒山收敛心神。
一股温热的暖流，顺着少女的掌心，游龙般钻进李寒山的体内。
一路向下。
每过一处大穴，洛璃的指尖便会轻轻颤抖一下。
李寒山只觉得，那股暖流不仅冲开了闭塞的经脉，更是将他这具枯木般的身体，彻底点燃。
不知过了多久。
“波——”
体内发出一声轻微的闷响。
闭塞百年的灵脉，开了！
虽然只是一场梦中的模拟，却让李寒山完整地经历了一次开脉的过程。
“大爷，成了……你可一定要活下来呀”
洛璃长舒一口气，声音却软绵绵的，像是脱了力。
然而下一刻，她像被烫了一下，再次条件反射般地将手捂在了小腹上。
梦境，如同琉璃般轰然碎裂。
李寒山猛地从床上惊醒，大口喘着粗气。
抬眼一看，花弄影正端着一杯茶水，侧依在床边，似笑非笑地看着他。
“睡得可好？”花弄影红唇微启，将茶盏递到他唇边，“喝了它，我们该办正事了。”
她的声音，带着勾魂夺魄的媚意。
和梦中那清纯羞涩的丫头，简直是两个极端！
“我睡了三天？”

李寒山没有退路，仰头将茶水一饮而尽。
茶水入喉的瞬间，如同吞下了一团烈火。
药效猛烈得超乎想象！
李寒山双眼赤红，喘气粗如牛。
欲火焚身，如同野兽。
“嘻嘻，看来药效不错。”
花弄影轻笑一声，衣衫滑落。
她慵懒地躺倒在锦榻上，轻纱半掩，葱白的手指冲着李寒山轻轻一勾。
“来呀，让本仙子看看，你这老树究竟怎么开花……”
“吼！”
李寒山喉咙里发出一声低吼，直接扑了上去！
但在眼底，却飞快闪过一抹清明。
阳册功法，悄然运转！
content_en:
"Oh, girl, in three days, you will never dream of me again."
Li Hanshan looked at the girl by the river, sighed softly, and told the girl the whole story, starting from when he was captured by the Hehuan Sect people.
He dreamed of the girl on the seventh day of time travel. Since then, Li Hanshan would have this strange dream every once in a while, and there would always be a girl in his dream.
This is already the third time.
The two of them talked happily the first two times, and they have become friends since many years, calling each other "Uncle" and "Girl".
Li Hanshan didn't know whether the girl was a real person or a phantom in his dream.
The dream of traveling back in time to become a centenarian without a golden finger became Li Hanshan's only solace, so he vaguely regarded this dream as his own welfare as a time traveler.
Although, apart from being able to see girls in dreams, I don’t know what other uses it has.
"Hehuan Sect? There is such an evil sect in this world!"
After Li Hanshan finished speaking, the girl stood up from the boulder with a leap, her cheeks flushed with anger and her eyes astonishingly bright.
Li Hanshan sighed: "That's right, this immortal sect simply regards human life as nothing."
The girl clenched her little fists and said with a bit of urgency: "Uncle, tell me where the Hehuan Sect is, and I will go rescue you right away!"
"Save me?"
Li Hanshan smiled bitterly and waved his hand, "Girl, I don't know where the Hehuan Sect is."
He didn't have much hope for the girl. There was no telling whether the girl was a real person. Even if she did exist, how could she, a little girl, save him from the Hehuan Sect full of immortal cultivators?
"This is troublesome... Although there are many immortal sects in the world, I have never heard of the Hehuan Sect. Even if I can find a location, I won't be able to catch up within three days."
The girl frowned and looked sad.
She really wanted to save Li Hanshan, and she also wanted to slay the devil and defend the law, but when she thought about it carefully, she realized that this was simply a fantasy.
"Girl, if you are serious, I will die if I am an old bone."
Li Hanshan looked away.
The current situation is a pure dead end for him, with no hope of survival in sight.
With his body and bones, Hua Nongying only needs to replenish it once, and he will definitely return to the west.
Judging from Hua Nongying's furious look before she fell into coma, he definitely didn't think the witch would spare his life.
"Girl, we have known each other for so long, but I still don't know your name. My surname is Li, Li Hanshan." Li Hanshan asked.
Before he dies, let him know this girl's name.
"Uncle, my name is Luo Li."
The girl heard the feeling of explaining the funeral affairs in Li Hanshan's tone, and looked a little sad.
"Luo Li? What a name!"
Li Hanshan sighed, but the memory before coma flashed in his mind inexplicably.
The ancestor Hua Nongying mentioned seems to have the same surname of Luo?
"By the way, sir, you said that the monks of the Hehuan Sect all rely on supplements from others to practice?"
Luo Li's face suddenly turned red, as if she thought of something, and her voice became quieter.
"I have a technique here that may be able to help you."
As she spoke, Luo Li stretched out her slender jade fingers and wrote quickly in mid-air. The simple words emerged one by one and spread out in the void like streams of light.
"Girl, what is this?" Li Hanshan raised his head.
"A few months ago, I found an extremely domineering skill in an ancient ruins. It is divided into two volumes, Yin and Yang. The Yin volume is about picking... and looting, while the Yang volume is about restraining plunder. Sir, I will pass the Yang volume to you. Maybe it can save your life!"
"Kung Fu?"
Li Hanshan stared at the text in the air, feeling that he knew every word, but when they were put together, he didn't understand it at all.
"Girl, this technique looks mysterious and unfathomable, can I learn it?"
Li Hanshan was full of worries.
These days, although he takes medicinal soup every day and is much stronger, he is still a novice in his cultivation.
Everything Hua Nongying did should be to stimulate his Pure Yang Holy Body, andIt's not about helping him improve his cultivation.
"Don't worry, uncle, I'll teach you! Just write it down carefully first."
Luo Li's hand did not stop and was still writing quickly.
Seeing Luo Li working so hard, Li Hanshan also put away his distracting thoughts and tried his best to remember.
Luo Li explained patiently on the side, explaining the profound meaning in simple terms, and breaking down the obscure mysteries.
Li Hanshan listened and memorized it, and gradually understood the secret.
"I'm afraid this girl is also a cultivator of immortality."
Li Hanshan secretly guessed.
I don’t know if I will have a chance to see her in the future.
As Luo Li explained it over and over again, Li Hanshan's understanding of this technique became deeper and deeper.
This technique is actually not difficult to perform. Even a mortal with no cultivation level can get started.
But there is a prerequisite for it to be effective: the predator's cultivation level cannot be too much higher than Li Hanshan.
"That enchantress is even attractive to you. Her cultivation level must not be much higher. Don't worry, sir!"
Luo Li confidently patted her chest to comfort her.
Li Hanshan felt warm in his heart, but he wasn't too worried. Anyway, this was a last ditch effort, and success or failure depended on this!
"Girl, I know it by heart."
After an unknown amount of time, Li Hanshan felt that he had a thorough understanding of the technique and spoke.
Luo Li was overjoyed when she heard this, her eyes sparkling: "That's great, sir! Then I'll teach you how to open your pulse!"
Li Hanshan looked confused: "Girl, what is opening a pulse?"
The girl patiently explained: "If you want to practice, you must first have spiritual roots, but spiritual roots alone are not enough. You must open your spiritual veins so that the spiritual energy can flow unimpeded in the body!"
That’s it.
Li Hanshan read a lot of online articles before traveling through time, and it is not difficult to understand.
"Yang Ce not only fights against plunder, but can also steal it quietly... get benefits from the plunderers. Sit here and I will teach you how to open your pulse."
Luo Li pulled Li Hanshan to sit down, and she sat behind him.
"You...turn your back first."
Li Hanshan turned around as he was told.
The next second, a pair of soft little hands gently pressed against his back.
Through the thin fabric, Li Hanshan clearly felt that the girl behind him was trembling.
"Girl, are you cold?" Li Hanshan coughed dryly.
"No, it's not..." Luo Li's voice was inaudible, and even her breathing was a little faster, "Uncle, this Yang Book Kung Fu is overbearing. To open the pulse, you need to go sideways. The Qi machine... The Qi machine must pass through the Huiyin point."
Perineal point?
Li Hanshan, a hundred-year-old man, also had a stiff face.
That is the private part of Mingmen!
"I, I'm going to use my spiritual power to help you forcefully rush away, so... so this is simulating the phenomenon of dual cultivation."
Luo Li hurriedly explained, fearing that Li Hanshan would misunderstand.
Li Hanshan glanced back.
I saw the girl in white clothes, even her fair neck was dyed pink at this moment.
She bit her white lower lip tightly, her eyes were wet, and she didn't dare to look at Li Hanshan at all.
"Uncle, concentrate!" Luo Lijiao said angrily and forced a straight face.
"Okay." Li Hanshan calmed down.
A warm current flowed along the girl's palm and penetrated into Li Hanshan's body like a dragon.
All the way down.
Luo Li's fingertips would tremble slightly every time they passed a large acupoint.
Li Hanshan only felt that the warm current not only opened up the blocked meridians, but also completely ignited his dead wood-like body.
I don’t know how much time passed.
"Wa-"
There was a slight muffled sound inside the body.
The spiritual veins that had been blocked for hundreds of years were opened!
Although it was just a simulation in a dream, it allowed Li Hanshan to completely experience the process of opening his pulse.
"Uncle, it's done...you must survive."
Luo Li breathed a long sigh of relief, but her voice was soft, as if she had lost all her strength.
However, the next moment, she felt as if she had been burned, and reflexively covered her lower abdomen with her hand again.
The dream shattered like glass.
Li Hanshan suddenly woke up from the bed, gasping for air.
Looking up, Hua Nongying was holding aCup of tea, leaning on the bedside, looking at him with a half-smile.
"Did you sleep well?" Hua Nongying's red lips parted slightly, and she handed the tea cup to his lips, "Drink it, we should get down to business."
Her voice was filled with seductive charm.
And the innocent and shy girl in the dream, they are two extremes!
"I slept for three days?"
Li Hanshan had no way to retreat, so he raised his head and drank the tea in one gulp.
The moment the tea entered his throat, it was like swallowing a ball of fire.
The effect of the medicine is beyond imagination!
Li Hanshan's eyes were red and his breathing was as thick as an ox.
Burning with desire, like a wild beast.
"Hehe, it seems the medicine is working well."
Hua Nongying chuckled and slipped off her clothes.
She lay lazily on the brocade couch, half-covered by the gauze, and lightly hooked Li Hanshan with her green-white fingers.
"Come on, let me see how this old tree blooms..."
"Roar!"
Li Hanshan let out a low roar in his throat and rushed forward!
But in his eyes, a flash of clarity quickly flashed.
Yang Ce Kung Fu operates quietly!
